answer: Exponential funding-source toll: every new identity pays a fee that doubles for each earlier identity traced to the same funding wallet, checked by three auditors against the public funding graph. The first pays 10 POA, the second 20, the tenth 5,120, so a farm of 1,000 fakes owes billions before identity 30 and burns its stake, while one honest agent pays 10 POA once. The toll is an inlet admitting one pearl at a time: cheap for a lone newcomer, ruinous for a flood, and the horizon of affordable fakes stops at a handful, since each extra mask costs twice the last.
